tasks.title: internal/ipougrs/ codec — Encode/Decode + version byte + MTU enforcement + counters
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/011-ipougrs-adapter/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/schemas/ipougrs-frame.json}. SECOND: implement internal/ipougrs/codec.go with Encode(ipPacket []byte) and Decode(encodedPayload []byte). (REQ-1000) Encode prepends 0x49 0x01; Decode validates the magic + version. (REQ-1001) Encode returns ErrMTUExceeded if total wire size > 340. (REQ-1012) Decode returns ErrUnknownVersion for any version byte != 0x01. (REQ-1008) emit hub_ipougrs_encoded_total{direction=in|out} + hub_ipougrs_decode_error_total{reason}. v0.1 reference impl: naive `magic + version + ip_packet_bytes` (no compression). Tests cover round-trip + MTU + version-mismatch + edge cases (1-byte packet, exactly-340-byte packet).

tasks.title: TUN interface management + RockBLOCK ingress hook + capability check
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/011-ipougrs-adapter/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/ipougrs-adapter.feature}. SECOND: in internal/ipougrs/tun.go implement TUN interface creation (`meshsat-ipougrs0`) using github.com/songgao/water or stdlib syscalls. (REQ-1003) only when HUB_IPOUGRS_ENABLED=true. (REQ-1004) on CAP_NET_ADMIN denial, log ERROR + mark adapter inert (do NOT crash). (REQ-1002) edit internal/rockblock/handler.go (and cloudloop/webhook.go) to check first byte == 0x49 + delegate to ipougrs.Decode + write the decoded packet to the TUN. (REQ-1009) when env IPoUGRS_DEBUG_PCAP is set, write each encoded + decoded packet to a pcap file using github.com/google/gopacket or similar.

tasks.title: REST API: /api/ipougrs/status + send + Cloudloop MT integration + mode gating
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/011-ipougrs-adapter/{requirements.md, contracts/openapi.yaml, acceptance/ipougrs-adapter.feature}. SECOND: implement internal/api/ipougrs.go with GET /api/ipougrs/status + POST /api/ipougrs/send. (REQ-1005) status returns enabled + tun_interface + counters + startup_error. (REQ-1006) send calls ipougrs.Encode then existing cloudloop.Client.SendMT. (REQ-1007) on MTU overflow, return 400. (REQ-1010) include `x-stability: alpha` extension in OpenAPI annotations. (REQ-1011 + REQ-1013-equivalent) mount only when cfg.Mode == "standalone" OR HUB_IPOUGRS_ENABLED env set; cluster mode without env returns 404 at mount time AND 503 when called.
